d: Jet black hair is styled into long, flowing twin tails with blunt-cut bangs framing a youthful, teenage face. The eyes are a vivid crimson red with a sharp, focused expression. A slender build is dressed in a white and black ruffled maid outfit accented with purple ribbons, a white apron, and purple thigh-high stockings. Signature details include a white frilled headpiece, a black tactical utility belt with purple pouches, a gas mask hanging from the hip, and a large black futuristic firearm held in black gloved hands.
